```plato

    //==
    // # Solving a set of joints
    //
    // The same fold the contact solver uses, over an array of joints instead of an
    // array of contact rows: one pass visits every joint once in order, and the
    // solve runs a fixed number of passes. Joints and contacts converge together
    // when their passes are interleaved; running all the joint passes and then all
    // the contact passes lets the contacts undo the joints, which reads as a
    // ragdoll whose limbs stretch on the frames it lands.

    // One pass over every distance joint.
    SolveDistanceJointPass(bodies: Array<SolverBody3D>, joints: Array<DistanceJoint>,
        stiffness: Number, seconds: Number): Array<SolverBody3D>
        => joints.Reduce(bodies, (acc, joint) => SolveJoint(acc, joint, stiffness, seconds));
```
